one_change: Declare subject=[event] for involves and enforce that opt-in manifest subject shape in extraction guidance and clean-audit validation.

revert_reason: The clean estimand stayed below the 0.6 gate and the evolves_into_lore healthy control regressed, so the one change and its scoped artifacts must not become the candidate baseline.
